dict.string: NomiFun uses the microphone for voice input and for websites that you explicitly allow in the built-in browser.
NomiFun lets websites use the camera only after you explicitly allow the request in the built-in browser.
NomiFun shares your location with a website only after you explicitly allow the request in the built-in browser.
NomiFun connects to local websites, SSH hosts, companion devices, and services only when you ask it to.
